comment: Placement constraints for bwa_layout_tool (copy next to cave_layout.json and run the tool there). Room space, metres, origin = FLOOR CENTRE, +Y up, +Z forward (toward the far / main-screen wall); observer ears ~1.4 m up. From the overhead plan (imperial callouts x 25.4 mm/in). AXIS MAP: X is the LONG axis = 163-7/16 in (4.151 m); Z = 146-7/16 in (3.720 m); Y = 97-3/4 in (2.483 m) structure height. 'bounds' = speaker truss. 'nogo' = CAVE screen cube (screens + observer; speakers go BEHIND, in the truss<->screen gap: ~0.60 m/side in X, ~0.40 m/side in Z). 'obstacles' = the four 522x494x198 mm projectors, Y CENTRED ON THE STRUCTURE TOP (2.483 m) per note, so each spans y 2.384..2.582. PROJECTOR X/Z CENTRES ARE APPROXIMATE: the plan locates a central overhead cluster but the four centres could not be uniquely resolved, so they are a plausible non-overlapping 2x2 at +/-0.65 m - nudge each in the tool (or send the four centres for an exact drop-in). Building wall is >= 28-11/16 in (0.729 m) beyond the truss, so 'bounds' is the mount line, not the wall. 'label' is ignored by the loader.

bounds.label: speaker truss: 163-7/16 in (X) x 146-7/16 in (Z) x 97-3/4 in tall (Y); wall >=0.729 m beyond

nogo.label: CAVE screen cube 116-9/16 (X) x 115-5/16 in (Z) full height: screens + observer; speakers go behind
